Here we follow the terminals between modules without expanding their internal transistors.

Combinational circuits recalculate whenever an input reaches a terminal, and their results travel along the next wires. A value arriving at a register and that register storing it are separate events.

Its two read ports produce separate values simultaneously, and its one write port stores the result on a clock edge. An instruction can place its result elsewhere while preserving its inputs.
r0 は常に0で、書き込みは捨てます。CMP r1, r2 は SUB r0,: r0 always reads as zero and discards writes. CMP r1, r2 is an alias for SUB r0, r1, r2. It keeps the flags without storing the difference, so comparison needs no separate data path. The roles of r6 and r7 as SP/LR are conventions used later; here they are general-purpose registers.
命令は RAM から16 bitずつ取り込みます。FIELDS は命令を切り分け: Instructions arrive from RAM as 16-bit words. FIELDS separates register numbers and sign-extended immediates; DECODE selects the ALU operation, input sources, and destination. ALU performs arithmetic, logic, and shifts. B SRC and WRITEBACK choose the values required by the current instruction.

Z は結果が0、C は桁上がり（減算では借り）、N は結果の最上位 bit、V: Z means the result is zero; C means carry (borrow for subtraction); N is the result's top bit; and V indicates signed overflow. Signed comparison cannot use N alone. For example, 32767 − (−1) looks negative in 16 bits, so JLT tests whether N and V differ.
分岐先は PC + 1 + 符号付きオフセットです。PC+1 と分岐先を並行に作: The branch target is PC + 1 + a signed offset. PC+1 and the branch target are calculated in parallel, and NEXT PC chooses between them using the saved flags and branch condition. This is a single-cycle implementation: one continuous combinational circuit prepares everything from instruction fetch to writeback. Even if the path is long, the next clock does not arrive halfway through it.

LD/ST、ベースレジスタ＋即値による番地計算、メモリからの書き戻しを加えます。: Adds LD/ST, base-register-plus-immediate addressing, and writeback from memory.
FT16 はロード/ストア型です。ADD はレジスタ間で計算し、メモリから取り出: FT16 is a load/store architecture. ADD operates on registers; LD brings data from memory and ST writes it back. To process an array, keep an address in a register and repeat LD → calculation → ST. Instructions and data are both 16-bit words in the same RAM.
番地はバイト単位ではなく語単位です。r1 = 0x0080 なら [r1+1]: Addresses count words, not bytes. With r1 = 0x0080, [r1+1] refers to the next 16-bit word at 0x0081. Instruction PC also increases by one. RAM has 512 words, and the program must keep its code and data from overlapping.
ストアの番地・データ・書き込み許可: Store address, data, and write enable
ST r2, [r1+3] は r1 と3から保存先の番地を作り、r2 の中身を: ST r2, [r1+3] forms a destination address from r1 and 3, then stores r2 there. ADDR carries the address; the other RF output carries the value to write. For LD, the same address calculation is followed by a MEMORY read, and WRITEBACK selects that value for the destination register.
読み出し・書き込みの許可も配線で届きます。番地が計算できただけでは書きません。S: Read and write enables also arrive over wires. Calculating an address alone does not write anything. Memory changes only on a clock where the ST write is enabled. Blue markers in the memory display indicate instruction locations; orange markers indicate data accesses.
単一サイクル実装の2ポートメモリ: Two-port memory in the single-cycle implementation
単一サイクルでは、LD の命令を読むことと、その命令が指定するデータを読むことが: A single-cycle LD needs both its instruction and the data it references within the same clock interval. This implementation therefore has two ports, one for instructions and one for data. It does not contain two copies of memory.
ポートを増やすには回路が必要です。段階5では時間を分けて1ポートを共用し、段階6: Extra ports require extra circuitry. Stage 5 shares one port over time; stage 6 overlaps instructions and encounters contention again; stage 7 places separate caches in front of memory. This is the starting point for changing the implementation while preserving the ISA's promise of one shared memory.
ベースレジスタと符号拡張した6 bit即値を加え、16 bitの有効番地を作りま: Adds the base register and a sign-extended 6-bit immediate to form a 16-bit effective address.
命令用とデータ用の入口を持つ共通の RAM。ST の許可でクロック時に書き込みま: Shared RAM with instruction and data ports. Writes on the clock when ST is enabled.
ALU の結果か、メモリの読み出し値かを選んで RF へ戻します。: Selects either the ALU result or the memory read value and returns it to RF.
符号付きバブルソートは、配列の隣り合う値を LD で比較し、順序が逆なら ST: Signed bubble sort uses LD to compare adjacent array elements and ST to swap them if they are out of order. JLT/JGE handle comparisons involving negative numbers.
リンクレジスタによる関数呼び出しと、スタックによる値の保存を学びます。: Learn function calls through a link register and saving values on a stack.
PC+1 をリンクレジスタへ残す JAL、レジスタの番地へ飛ぶ JALR、ソフト: Introduces JAL, which saves PC+1 in a link register; JALR, which jumps to a register-based address; and a software stack.
JAL は PC 相対の行き先へ飛ぶと同時に、次の命令の番地 PC+1 を r7: JAL jumps to a PC-relative target while saving the next instruction's address, PC+1, in r7 (LR). RET is an alias for JALR r0, r7, 0 and puts LR back into PC. Because writes to JALR's destination r0 are discarded, returning does not save another link.
JALR rd, rs1, imm は行き先を rs1+imm で求めます。CA: JALR rd, rs1, imm calculates its target as rs1+imm. CALLR r2 is an alias for JALR r7, r2, 0. A target can therefore be stored as data in memory or a register, enabling function pointers.
関数の中から別の関数を JAL で呼ぶと、r7 の前の戻り番地が上書きされます。: Calling another function with JAL overwrites the previous return address in r7. A nested computation such as factorial must save its current LR and any needed arguments in memory before calling again. Decrease SP (r6) to reserve space, save with ST, then restore with LD and increase SP after returning.
スタック専用のメモリや PUSH/POP 回路はありません。番地の小さい方へ伸ば: There is no dedicated stack memory or PUSH/POP circuit. By convention, the stack grows toward smaller addresses and SP points to the last word pushed. Ordinary instructions such as ADDI r6, -2 and ST r7, [r6+1] implement it. Remember that ADDI used to move SP also changes the flags.
呼び出し命令の回路と呼び出し規約: Call circuitry and the calling convention
書き戻しの候補に PC+1、次の PC の候補にレジスタから作った番地を加えます: PC+1 becomes another writeback source, and a register-based address becomes another next-PC source. The decoder fixes JAL's destination at r7; JALR uses the instruction's rd field. The call itself does not read or write memory.
呼び出し規約では r1〜r3 は引数や作業用、r1 は戻り値、r4/r5 は呼ば: The calling convention uses r1–r3 for arguments and temporary values, r1 for a return value, and r4/r5 for values the callee must preserve. The circuit does not enforce these rules; they let independently written functions cooperate.
演算結果の代わりに戻り番地を RF へ保存します。: Stores a return address in RF instead of an arithmetic result.
メモリ番地と同じ加算器で間接ジャンプの行き先も求めます。: Uses the memory-address adder to calculate an indirect jump target as well.
SP と LR は汎用レジスタ。保存・復元はプログラムに従います。: SP and LR are general-purpose registers. The program performs all saving and restoring.
再帰による階乗では、SP の減少と増加、LR の退避と復元を対にして追います。機: In recursive factorial, pair each decrease in SP with its increase, and each saved LR with its restoration. The feature experiment uses a leaf function, so it can return without a stack.
メモリマップド I/O と、タイマ割り込みの受け付け・復帰を学びます。: Learn memory-mapped I/O and how timer interrupts are accepted and returned from.
メモリマップド I/O、タイマ、割り込み、EPC/CAUSE/ESTAT とトラ: Adds memory-mapped I/O, a timer, interrupts, EPC/CAUSE/ESTAT, and trap handling.
LD/ST の番地が 0xFFF0 なら LED、0xFFF1 ならスイッチ、0: An LD/ST address of 0xFFF0 selects LEDs; 0xFFF1 selects switches; 0xFFF2 selects the timer period; and 0xFFF3 selects its pending status. ADDR DECODE generates RAM and device selects, and the read MUX returns the selected device's value. Programs use the same instructions as for memory.
タイマは4クロックで1カウントし、指定の周期に達すると要求を保持します。周期を書: The timer counts once every four clocks and latches a request when it reaches the configured period. Writing the period resets the count to zero; a period of zero stops it. Writing the pending-status register clears the request. Follow the wires to distinguish reading device state from changing it.
割り込み時の状態保存と復帰: Saving state on an interrupt and returning
要求があり、STATUS の IE が1なら、命令の境界で割り込みを受け付けます: When a request is pending and IE in STATUS is 1, the CPU accepts the interrupt at an instruction boundary. It saves the address of the instruction not yet executed in EPC, cause 1 in CAUSE, and the previous enable state and flags in ESTAT. It then clears IE and directs PC to the shared entry at 0x0001.
入口の処理をハンドラと呼びます。要求を消し、必要な処理を行って RETI すると: The code at that entry is the handler. It clears the request, performs the required work, then executes RETI to restore the location and state from EPC and ESTAT. General-purpose registers are not saved automatically; the handler must save and restore any values it uses.
TRAP は原因を判定し、CSR は復帰に必要な状態を保持します。GATE はそ: TRAP determines the cause, and CSR holds the state needed to return. GATE blocks register, memory, and flag writes by the instruction that would otherwise execute on that clock. Address calculations still run, leaving the inputs available for inspection.
同じトラップの仕組みを、段階8では保護違反やシステムコールにも使います。単一サイ: Stage 8 reuses this trap mechanism for protection violations and system calls. In this single-cycle stage, only one instruction needs to be interrupted, making the behavior easier to trace.
番地から装置を選びます。I/O のスイッチは直接操作できます。: Selects a device from its address. The I/O switches can be operated directly.
クロックを数えて要求を保持。CPU の許可とは独立に要求が立ちます。: Counts clocks and latches a request. Requests arise independently of the CPU's interrupt enable.
要求と許可から中断を決め、実行を取り消す命令の書き込みを遮断します。: Uses the request and enable to decide when to interrupt, and blocks writes by the canceled instruction.
EPC・CAUSE・ESTAT を保存し、RETI 時に元の状態を復元します。: Saves EPC, CAUSE, and ESTAT, then restores the previous state on RETI.
タイマ割り込みのサンプルでは、本体とハンドラを行き来します。機能を確認する実験で: The timer-interrupt sample alternates between the main program and its handler. The feature experiment starts with a request already pending, so you can observe acceptance and return without waiting for a timer period.
1命令を複数クロックで実行し、ALU とメモリを共用する実装を学びます。: Learn an implementation that executes each instruction over multiple clocks and shares its ALU and memory.
命令の意味は段階4と同じ。状態機械・途中結果レジスタ・1ポートメモリ・ready: Instruction meanings remain the same as stage 4. The implementation changes to a state machine, intermediate registers, one-port memory, and waits for ready.
命令の処理段階と状態機械: Instruction phases and the state machine
単一サイクルでは、命令の取得から結果の保存までが1クロックでした。マルチサイクル: In a single-cycle implementation, instruction fetch through result storage took one clock. A multicycle implementation splits this work into FETCH, DECODE, EXEC, MEM, and MEMWB (or ALUWB for arithmetic). Several clocks complete one instruction, each storing the values needed by the next phase.
STATE が現在の仕事を覚え、CONTROL が命令と状態から各 MUX と書: STATE remembers the current phase, while CONTROL uses the instruction and state to select MUX inputs and write enables. Compare the different results of One instruction and One clock.
ALU・メモリの共用と途中結果の保持: Sharing ALU and memory; retaining intermediate results
命令を読む FETCH とデータを読む MEM は別のクロックなので、同じ1ポー: Instruction fetch in FETCH and data access in MEM occur on different clocks, so both can use the same single memory port. The ALU is also reused for PC+1, arithmetic, and effective-address calculation. Switching input MUXes gives the same adder different jobs.
途中で入力が変わっても結果を失わないよう、IR に命令、A/B に読み出したレジ: IR holds the instruction, A/B hold register values, ALUOUT holds the arithmetic result, and MDR holds memory data so later input changes do not destroy intermediate results. Reducing circuitry requires this temporary storage and sequencing control.
要求を出してもメモリがまだ値を返せなければ ready = L のままです。CO: If memory cannot return a value yet, ready remains L after a request. CONTROL holds the current state and advances on the clock when ready becomes H. Progress depends on an arriving response, rather than a fixed instruction animation.
短い経路を複数回通るので、1クロックの仕事量は減りますが、命令あたりクロック数: Traversing shorter paths several times reduces the work per clock but increases clocks per instruction (CPI). That does not necessarily make execution faster. The comparison display includes logic depth as well as clock count. Treat t separately from performance: it is observation time that depends on layout.
現在の段階と ready に応じて、次の段階と各書き込み許可を決めます。: Uses the current phase and ready to choose the next phase and all write enables.
取り込んだ命令を、処理が終わるまで保持します。: Holds the fetched instruction until processing finishes.
入力の選択を切り替え、PC の更新と命令の演算・番地計算を担います。: Switches input sources to update PC and perform arithmetic and address calculations.
メモリ応答を保存して、後の WB でレジスタへ渡します。: Saves the memory response and passes it to a register during a later WB phase.
段階3と同じ階乗を実行し、結果が変わらないことを確認します。実装の比較では、多い: Run the same factorial program as stage 3 and confirm the result is unchanged. Compare the larger clock count together with the shorter logic path.
3段パイプラインで命令を並行して処理し、データ依存と資源の競合を確認します。: Overlap instructions in a three-stage pipeline and examine data dependencies and resource contention.
IF・DX・MW の3段と段間レジスタ、依存検出、フォワーディングを導入します。: Introduces IF, DX, and MW stages, pipeline registers, dependency detection, and forwarding.
3段パイプラインと段間レジスタ: The three-stage pipeline and its registers
IF は命令の取り込み、DX は解読と演算、MW はメモリアクセスと書き戻しです: IF fetches instructions, DX decodes and executes, and MW accesses memory and writes back. Saving instruction values and control signals between stages lets each stage process a different instruction. Each instruction still takes time to traverse the pipeline, but the aim is to complete one instruction per clock in steady state.
パイプライン図の同じ番地が次の段へ移る様子を追います。回路図は上段を左から右に進: Follow the same instruction address as it moves between stages in the pipeline chart. The circuit runs left to right across the upper row, then back along the lower row. Destination register numbers and valid bits travel between stages along with data.
次の命令が前の命令の結果を使うとき、RF から読む値は古い可能性があります。HA: When an instruction needs its predecessor's result, the value read from RF may be stale. HAZARD detects the dependency and waits, or FORWARD sends the MW result directly to a DX input. A stall holds pipeline registers and inserts an invalid empty slot (a bubble) where needed.
3段版は MW でメモリを読み、その値を同じクロックの DX の ALU へ渡せ: The three-stage version can read memory in MW and pass that value to the DX ALU in the same clock interval. This can avoid a data-dependency stall immediately after a load, but creates a long combinational path: memory → forwarding MUX → ALU. Stage 6b splits that path.
1ポートメモリでは MW のデータアクセスと IF の命令取り込みが競合します。: With one memory port, a data access in MW conflicts with instruction fetch in IF. This is a structural hazard. It can cause a wait even without register dependencies; try two ports to isolate its effect.
この段階は I/O を持ちますが、割り込みと保護はまだ統合していません。ISA: This stage includes I/O but does not yet integrate interrupts or protection. Instruction encoding and arithmetic keep their meanings, but available features follow the mmio profile. Stage 9 adds traps to the combined implementation.
取り込んだ命令と PC を保持し、次の命令と区別します。: Holds the fetched instruction and its PC, keeping it distinct from the next instruction.
読みたいレジスタと未完了の保存先を比べ、待つ必要を検出します。: Compares source registers with pending destinations to detect when waiting is necessary.
MW の新しい値を DX に直接渡す入力を選びます。: Selects inputs that pass new values directly from MW to DX.
保持・空きを入れる・取り消すという段間制御をまとめます。: Coordinates holding, inserting bubbles, and canceling instructions between stages.
ハザードの見本を使ってストールだけの場合とフォワーディングを比較します。同じ最終: Use the hazard sample to compare stalling alone with forwarding. Check that forwarding reduces waits while preserving the same final state.
5段パイプラインのストール、フォワーディング、フラッシュ、分岐予測を比較します。: Compare stalls, forwarding, flushes, and branch prediction in a five-stage pipeline.
IF・ID・EX・MEM・WB の5段へ分割し、ロード待ち・フラッシュ・分岐予測: Splits execution into IF, ID, EX, MEM, and WB, and compares load waits, flushes, and branch prediction.
5段への分割とロード直後の依存: Five stages and dependencies immediately after a load
3段版の DX を ID（解読・読み出し）と EX（演算）に、MW を MEM（: DX from the three-stage version becomes ID (decode and register read) and EX (execute); MW becomes MEM (memory) and WB (writeback). More pipeline registers shorten each clock's combinational path. The next instruction uses a stage once its predecessor has moved on.
EX の算術結果は EX/MEM から次の EX へ転送できます。しかし LD: An arithmetic result from EX can be forwarded from EX/MEM to the next EX. An LD result, however, is unavailable until the end of MEM, too late for the immediately following instruction. HAZARD inserts a one-clock wait so the result can be forwarded from MEM/WB.
設定0は必要な値と分岐の確定を待ち、設定1はデータを転送して待ちを減らします。設: Mode 0 waits for operands and branch resolution; mode 1 forwards data to reduce waits. Mode 2 fetches following instructions without waiting for a branch, then flushes them if EX resolves a different target. Mode 3 predicts using a BTB containing previous targets and 2-bit history.
予測値は正しさの根拠にはしません。BRANCH は実際の次の PC と予測した: Predictions are never trusted for correctness. BRANCH compares the actual next PC with the predicted PC and corrects mismatches. Canceled instructions lose their valid bits so they cannot leave register or memory results behind. Incorrectly predicting a non-branch instruction as a branch is corrected too.
結果待ちはデータハザード、次の命令の番地が未確定なのは制御ハザード、MEM と: Waiting for a result is a data hazard; an unresolved next-instruction address is a control hazard; MEM and IF competing for one port is a structural hazard. Their causes differ, so forwarding alone cannot eliminate all waits.
CPI はクロック数÷完了命令数です。短い実験では、パイプラインを満たす時間や最: CPI is clock count divided by completed instructions. In short experiments, filling and draining the pipeline account for a large fraction of execution. Also compare performance with a longer, complete sample, and consider logic depth per clock alongside CPI.
値、レジスタ番号、制御信号、PC、有効ビットを同じ命令の組として保持します。: Keep data, register numbers, control signals, PC, and valid bits together as one instruction's state.
転送できる結果と、ロードのようにまだ待つ必要のある結果を区別します。: Distinguishes results that can be forwarded from results, such as loads, that still require a wait.
実際の次の番地と予測を比較し、行き先の修正を要求します。: Compares the actual next address with the prediction and requests a correction.
過去の行き先と分岐の履歴で次の取り込みを予測します。外れは必ず修正します。: Predicts the next fetch from past targets and branch history. Mispredictions are always corrected.
ハザードの見本では、4つの設定と1/2ポートを比較できます。短いロード依存と分岐: The hazard sample compares four modes and one or two ports. Use the short load-dependency and branch experiments to separate the causes, then return to CPI for the complete sample.
命令・データキャッシュのヒットとミス、主記憶へのアクセスを学びます。: Learn instruction and data cache hits and misses, and accesses to main memory.
分離した I/D キャッシュ、タグ比較、ミス処理、バス調停、遅い主記憶、FENC: Adds separate I/D caches, tag comparison, miss handling, bus arbitration, slow main memory, and FENCEI.
命令とデータの手前に、それぞれ4行×2語のキャッシュを置きます。ヒットすれば I: Instruction and data accesses each get a cache with four lines of two words. On hits, IF and MEM can use separate caches simultaneously. Main memory remains shared and is accessed only when needed. Separate I/D caches do not turn the ISA's memory into two memories.
番地をタグ・行番号・行内の位置に分けます。下位1 bit が2語のどちらか、次の: An address is split into a tag, line index, and word offset. The low bit selects one of two words; the next two bits select one of four lines; the remaining bits are the tag. A line is usable only when it is valid and its tag matches. Similar addresses with different tags refer to different data.
キャッシュミス時の補充と待ち: Refilling and waiting on a cache miss
ミスした制御器はバスへ補充を要求します。BUS ARBITER は I 側と D: A controller that misses requests a refill over the bus. BUS ARBITER sends I-side and D-side requests to main memory one at a time and returns each response to its requester. By default, a main-memory transfer takes four clocks. The waiting pipeline retains the values it needs.
一度使った語をまた使う時間的局所性と、隣の語を使う空間的局所性が効果の源です。機: Caches benefit from temporal locality (using a word again) and spatial locality (using nearby words). The feature experiment shows a first read also fetching its neighbor. Caches do not accelerate everything: line conflicts and refill waits remain.
この実装はライトスルーで、ST は主記憶にも反映します。ストアバッファやライトバ: This implementation is write-through, so ST also updates main memory. There is no store buffer or write-back policy. I/O addresses bypass the caches and go to devices, avoiding reads from stale copies of device state.
命令もメモリに置いたデータなので ST で書き換えられますが、I-CACHE は: Instructions are data in memory and can be changed with ST, but I-CACHE does not observe that write. FENCEI invalidates the instruction cache and refetches following instructions, making earlier writes visible. The code-modification sample demonstrates the problem of an old copy at the same address.
番地を分割し、保存したタグと valid を比較してヒットを判断します。: Splits the address and compares the stored tag and valid bit to determine a hit.
命令とデータの小さなコピーを別々に保持します。: Hold separate small copies of instructions and data.
ヒット時の応答、ミス時の補充要求、待ちと再開を制御します。: Control hit responses, refill requests on misses, waiting, and resumption.
2つの要求元が1つの遅い主記憶を順番に使えるようにします。: Lets two requesters take turns using one slow main memory.
キャッシュと局所性のサンプルは繰り返しアクセスを観察するものです。主記憶の待ちを: The cache-locality sample demonstrates repeated accesses. Change main-memory latency to compare the benefit of hits with the cost of misses.
権限モード、TLB による番地変換、メモリ保護を学びます。: Learn privilege modes, address translation through a TLB, and memory protection.
ユーザー/カーネルモード、I/D TLB、書き込み・実行権限、保護例外とシステム: Adds user/kernel modes, I/D TLBs, write and execute permissions, protection exceptions, and system calls. This stage returns to single-cycle execution for easier observation.
TLB による仮想番地から物理番地への変換: Translating virtual addresses to physical addresses
ユーザープログラムが使う番地を仮想番地、RAM に渡す番地を物理番地と呼びます。: Addresses used by user programs are virtual addresses; addresses sent to RAM are physical addresses. A page contains 32 words. The TLB translates the upper 11-bit page number while preserving the lower 5-bit offset. The same virtual address can be mapped to a different physical page.
I-TLB は命令、D-TLB はデータ用で各4エントリです。すべての有効なエン: I-TLB serves instructions and D-TLB serves data, with four entries each. All valid entries are compared in parallel. Kernel mode bypasses translation so the OS can access physical memory. A cache holds copies of data; a TLB holds address mappings. Their roles differ.
TLB のエントリには W（書き込み可）と X（実行可）があります。ST は W: Each TLB entry has W (writable) and X (executable) bits. ST requires W; instruction fetch requires X. An OS can make code executable but not writable, and data writable but not executable, preventing data from being executed as instructions. The OS establishes this W^X policy.
対応がないと TLB ミス、権限が足りないと保護違反の例外になります。ハードウェ: A missing mapping causes a TLB miss; insufficient permissions cause a protection exception. Hardware does not walk a page table. The OS inspects CAUSE and BADVA, fills an entry with TLBW if appropriate, and executes RETI. EPC points to the faulting instruction so it can be retried after repair.
ユーザーモードで制御レジスタを書き換えたり、割り込みを禁止したりすることはできま: User mode cannot change control registers or disable interrupts. SYSCALL deliberately traps to ask the OS to perform work. Because SYSCALL completes a request, its EPC points to the next instruction; a memory exception that needs repair and retry points to the faulting instruction itself.
ミニ OS は RAM に2つのプログラムをコピーし、TLB を設定し、ユーザー: The mini OS copies two programs into RAM, configures the TLBs, and runs them in user mode. It switches contexts on timer interrupts and handles system calls and TLB misses. It stops a program that jumps to a non-executable page. This is a small educational OS, not a model of every feature in a production OS.
命令の仮想番地を変換し、実行権限 X を確認します。: Translates the instruction's virtual address and checks execute permission X.
